findings.detail: A07 observed pct_sum is 47.26%, but the raw June 30, 2024 investment schedule total is 150.28% of net assets.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate check. The flag reports pct_sum=47.26%, while raw source anchors total investments at fair value of 1,385,068 against total net assets of 921,634, which the filing itself reports as 150.28%. The source percentage anchor therefore disagrees with the observed extracted percentage sum, indicating an extraction gap rather than a false alarm.
